_note: O Farol, cena 01 'A Luz que Chama' (2026-11-11; the user: 'a boss talk scene at the top of the lighthouse', a film cutscene and then the fight). Plays when the lantern room (farol-topo) opens. The room is an octagon: the great lamp at (11, 8), O Faroleiro (the Embered Wraith) before it at (11, 10) with his back to the stairs, the party by the stairs (Kael at (11, 14)). Only Kael and O Faroleiro are actors: whoever else is in the party stays where the map put them. Headings: 'n' looks from the stairs at the lamp.

steps.text: Faroleiro. A sua luz está levando os barcos para as pedras.

translations.en: Keeper. Your light is leading the ships onto the rocks.

steps.text: Quarenta anos. Nenhuma noite sem luz. Nem uma.

translations.en: Forty years. Not one night without the light. Not one.

steps.text: Enterraram o senhor no inverno passado.
Enterraram um homem. A luz não era o homem. A luz fica.

translations.en: They buried a man. The light was never the man. The light stays.

steps.text: E eles vêm, está vendo? Todo barco vem. Eu acendo, e eles voltam para casa.

translations.en: And they come, you see? Every ship comes. I light it, and they come home.

steps.text: Eles vêm para morrer. E depois sobem a praia andando, com a boca cheia de mar.

translations.en: They come to die. And then they walk up the beach with their mouths full of sea.

steps.text: Sobem para VIGIAR. A cinza acordou o que dormia lá embaixo, e um farol precisa de olhos. Eu dou a eles uma luz. Eles me dão a noite inteira.

translations.en: They come up to KEEP WATCH. The ash woke what slept below, and a lighthouse needs eyes. I give them a light. They give me the whole night.

steps.text: Então olhe para mim, Anselmo. Eu vou apagar essa lanterna.

translations.en: Then look at me, Anselmo. I'm putting that lantern out.
No one puts out my light.
